_comment: PRESET: pet accessories. Price bands are USD, from docs/research-findings-2026-11-23.md addendum §E (seller-tool data, directional; Etsy's own trend report confirms pet gifting searches doubled YoY). The pricing block's product/shipping costs are EXAMPLE placeholders, not live Printify catalog prices — replace them at Stage 5. Printify carries pet products (bandanas, beds, food mats); engraved collars/tags usually need a disclosed specialist production partner — either way the design must be YOURS or the buyer's own personalisation (Etsy Creativity Standards). This shop sells NO pet food or treats: treats are regulated animal feed (FDA/AAFCO + state licences), a different business.

affiliate_picks.channel: Amazon Associates — gift-guide and care content on the shop's blog/socials
affiliate_picks.notes: Promoted off Etsy only (docs/affiliate-model.md). Amazon Pets category rate ~3% (verify current table). Never your own Etsy listings — and this shop does not SELL treats itself (feed law, see _comment).

affiliate_picks.notes: Higher ticket; review only products you can describe honestly.

affiliate_picks.category: Grooming tools, brushes and pet beds
affiliate_picks.channel: Amazon Associates — social posts and gift guides
affiliate_picks.notes: Everyday re-orderables your buyers already buy; disclosure line on every post.

materials: Polyester bandana, printed design (copy the real spec from your provider at Stage 5)

creation_path: Stage 3 research names the breed/occasion micro-niche (generic bandanas are commoditised — 126K+ competing listings, tool-reported) and scores the candidate
Write the design brief: your artwork and the personalisation fields (pet name, breed silhouette you drew) — never a copied design, never health/calming claims (Etsy bans medical claims for any item)
Produce to spec: print-ready file at the provider's size/DPI, personalisation workflow tested with a sample order to yourself (Stage 4)
Build in Printify (or your disclosed partner) and price with pipeline/pricing.py on REAL costs (Stage 5)
Generate the listing pack with pipeline/listing.py (Stage 6), publish gate (Stage 7), read the live listing back
delivery: Printify (pet bandanas, beds, mats) or a disclosed production partner prints/ships per order; personalisation is the buyer's own name/text on YOUR design
launch_checklist: Stage 1: intake answered — existing shop health-checked (Etsy Payments active, bank verified, shop policies set, production partners disclosed); no shop yet → appendix walkthrough first (docs/appendix-shop-creation.md)
Stage 2: Printify connected; pet-product providers picked; production partners disclosed in Shop Manager AND on listings (Etsy requires it)
Stage 3: breed/occasion micro-niche scored with pipeline/scoring.py; generic bandanas fail the competition signal by default
Stage 4: designs original; personalisation flow tested; NO medical/calming/health claims anywhere; no natural-fur or banned animal materials (Etsy Prohibited Items policy)
Stage 5: real provider costs in the pricing config; bundles (collar + tag + bandana sets) priced as the margin play
Stage 6: listing pack generated; IP tripwire clean; size/weight and safety info honest (collars and small parts are a safety surface)
Stage 7: human approves the exact product + pack; publish; read the live listing back
Stage 8: watch sizing/personalisation errors and seasonal drops (list holiday lines 6-8 weeks early); weekly review scheduled
name: Pet Accessories
niche: Personalised pet accessories for a breed or occasion micro-niche (bandanas, collar/tag sets, portraits, mats) — generic pet products are the saturated end; breed + occasion + personalisation is the entry

pricing._comment: EXAMPLE COSTS ONLY (USD) — not live Printify catalog prices. Replace product_cost/shipping_cost at Stage 5.

products.notes: Strongest demand:competition ratio in the pet research; bundles (collar+tag+bandana) reported at $45-65

products.notes: Digital file at the low end, framed print at the top; Medium-High competition — your style is the differentiator

products.notes: Printify-carried POD product; sits inside the reported accessories band

products.name: Dog-mom / pet-parent sweatshirt
products.notes: The apparel crossover: personalised pet-parent sweatshirts are top apparel sellers (tool data)

summary: Personalised pet accessories — bandanas, collar/tag sets, portraits, mats — printed or made per order with a disclosed production partner. Research verdict (2026-11-23, addendum §E): Etsy's own trend report says pet gifting searches doubled YoY; the proven sellers are personalised collars/tags (top shops cite hundreds of thousands of sales), portraits, and breed-specific bandanas. Generic bandanas are commoditised and leashes alone are weak. NO treats or pet food in this shop — that is regulated animal feed, not a listing decision.
